name: Roth's Gugu Warra
sweep_summary: The only title hit for gugu1256 (Milojkovic 2013, 'semantic prosody' in corpus stylistics) is a Glottolog computerized language code mis-assignment from the title word 'improvement' (verbatim in the Glottolog record; it has nothing to do with this language or word stress. No first-hand stress statement for Roth's Gugu Warra was found: the prior check pass in the same directory had already established that the language is known only from Roth's 1898 wordlist and Sommer 1976/1999 notes, with the only Lamalamic stress remarks (Verstraete 2023 OGAL ch. 72: vowel-initial roots stressed on the second syllable) pertaining to Rimanggudinhma (mbar1253), not Roth's doculect. The language is not in the catalog; nothing to confirm or contradict. direct download and automated download were used for the Glottolog record.

earlier_scan.note: Only wordlist-level records (Roth 1898, Sommer 1976); no phonological description exists
